name: character-asset-cleanup
credential_policy: Do not store image-provider credentials, tokens, cookies or account data in the package or experiment record.
review_cadence: after the first two same-source A/B tests or any identity-drift failure
output_contract: Three concurrently generated guide images, followed only after all pass by one non-overwriting clean composite candidate and an experiment record.
rollback_boundary: Keep the approved source and all previous asset versions unchanged; reject the candidate or remove it from current selection without altering prior files.

intent.job_to_be_done: Clean an approved character asset through separated color-value, contour and volume guides without changing the character.
target_users: AI video creators using local agent skills
